# Tokyo Travelers

> > Comprehensive Japan travel guide specializing in budget shopping, 100-yen stores, and affordable dining across Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and Yokohama.

Tokyo Travelers helps visitors navigate Japan's major cities with detailed guides to Daiso locations, budget sushi restaurants, and practical shopping information. The site focuses on affordable travel options and includes payment information for international visitors using VISA, Master, JCB, and UnionPay cards.

## Key Topics

- Daiso 100-yen shops
- Budget shopping in Japan
- Tokyo travel guides
- Kyoto station area
- Osaka station area
- Yokohama shopping
- Cheap sushi chains
- Souvenir shopping
- Tokyo Skytree
- Ginza district
- Tsukiji area
- Payment methods (JCB, VISA, Master, UnionPay)
- Station area guides
- Budget dining
- Japan travel tips

## Budget Dining Guides

- [100 yen(cheap) sushi bars in Tokyo](https://www.tokyotravelers.com/100-yen-cheap-sushi-bars-in-tokyo): Guide to budget sushi chains in Tokyo: Hama Sushi, Kura Sushi, Sushiro

## Daiso 100-Yen Shop Locations

- [Daiso 100 yen shops around Kyoto station](https://www.tokyotravelers.com/daiso-100-yen-shops-around-kyoto-station): Daiso 100-yen shop locations near Kyoto station for budget souvenirs
- [Daiso 100 yen shops around Osaka station](https://www.tokyotravelers.com/daiso-100-yen-shops-around-osaka-station): Daiso store locations around Osaka station including Whity Umeda
- [Daiso 100 yen shops around Yokohama station area](https://www.tokyotravelers.com/daiso-100-yen-shops-around-yokohama-station-area): Daiso 100-yen shops near Yokohama station for souvenir shopping
